primary_text:

1️⃣ Skin remains hydrated even after reapplication
2️⃣ Comfortable, non-greasy finish suitable for daily wear
3️⃣ Reliable protection with very high UVA and UVB coverage

• Very water-resistant (up to 80 minutes)
• Non-comedogenic and oil-free
• Photostable UV filters that stay effective in sunlight
